'''Gerald''' "'''Andre'''" '''Jones Jr.''' (born October 25, 1998) is an American professional [[American football|football]] [[linebacker]] for the [[Buffalo Bills]] of the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns football|Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns]] and was selected by the [[Washington Commanders]] in the seventh round of the [[2023 NFL draft]].

==Early life and college==
Jones Jr. was born on October 25, 1998, in [[Varnado, Louisiana|Varnado]], a [[village (Louisiana)|village]] in [[Washington Parish, Louisiana]].<ref name="TheBeast">{{Cite web |last=Brugler |first=Dane |title=The Beast: 2023 NFL Draft Guide |url=https://cdn.theathletic.com/app/uploads/2023/04/10111751/TheBeast_NFL_Draft_Guide-1.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230410190932/https://cdn.theathletic.com/app/uploads/2023/04/10111751/TheBeast_NFL_Draft_Guide-1.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-date=April 10, 2023 |url-access=subscription |access-date=April 10, 2022 |website=[[The Athletic]] |pages=188 }}</ref> He attended Varnado High School, where he played football and basketball.<ref name="TheBeast"/> As a senior, he recorded 78 tackles, 6 sacks, a forced fumble, and blocked punt in football, earning him All-State and All-District honors.<ref name="TheBeast"/> Jones also caught 12 catches for 102 yards and two touchdowns as a [[tight end]].<ref name="TheBeast"/> He played [[college football]] as an [[outside linebacker]] for the [[Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns football|Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns]] at the [[University of Louisiana at Lafayette]] from 2017 to 2022.<ref name="TheBeast"/>

Jones was selected by the [[Washington Commanders]] in the seventh round (233rd overall) of the [[2023 NFL draft]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lichtenstein |first=Hannah |date=April 29, 2023 |title=Commanders draft DE Andre Jones with No. 233 overall pick |url=https://www.commanders.com/news/commanders-draft-de-andre-jones-with-no-233-overall-pick |access-date=29 April 2023 |website=Commanders.com}}</ref> He signed his four-year rookie contract on May 12, 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Selby |first=Zach |date=May 12, 2023 |title=Commanders sign KJ Henry, Chris Rodriguez Jr., Andre Jones Jr. to rookie deals |url=https://www.commanders.com/news/commanders-sign-kj-henry-chris-rodriguez-jr-andre-jones-jr-to-rookie-deals |access-date=12 May 2023 |website=Commanders.com}}</ref> Jones was waived by the team on August 27, 2024, and joined their [[practice squad]] the following day.<ref>{{cite web |title=Commanders sign 12 players to 2024 practice squad |url=https://www.commanders.com/news/commanders-sign-12-players-to-2024-practice-squad |website=Commanders.com |access-date=28 August 2024}}</ref> On January 28, 2025, Jones signed a reserve/future contract with the Commanders.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://commanderswire.usatoday.com/2025/01/28/washington-commanders-roster-moves-reserve-future-contracts/|work=USAToday.com|title=Commanders sign nine players to Reserve/Future contracts|first=Ivan|last=Lambert|date=January 28, 2025|accessdate=January 30, 2025}}</ref> On August 27, 2025, he was released as part of final roster cuts before the start of the 2025 season.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Zelby |first1=Zach |title=Commanders place Sam Cosmi on Reserve/PUP list; release 30 players |url=https://www.commanders.com/news/commanders-place-sam-cosmi-on-reserve-pup-list-release-30-players |website=Commanders.com |access-date=August 27, 2025 |date=August 26, 2025}}</ref>

===Buffalo Bills===
On August 28, 2025, Jones signed with the practice squad of the [[Buffalo Bills]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.buffalobills.com/news/bills-sign-de-andre-jones-jr-and-cb-jalen-kimber-to-the-practice-squad-release-cb-daequan-hardy|work=BuffaloBills.com|title=Bills sign DE Andre Jones Jr. and CB Jalen Kimber to the practice squad, release CB Daequan Hardy|date=August 28, 2025|accessdate=August 28, 2025|first=Maddy|last=Glab}}</ref> On January 19, 2026, he signed a reserve/futures contract with Buffalo.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bills announce 2026 reserve/future signings |url=https://www.buffalobills.com/news/bills-announce-2026-reserve-future-signings |website=BuffaloBills.com |access-date=20 January 2026}}</ref>

'''Andre Davis''' (born October 7, 1975) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[defensive tackle]] for one season with the [[Jacksonville Jaguars]] of the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Southern Jaguars football|Southern Jaguars]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pro-football-reference.com/players/D/DaviAn21.htm |title=Andre Davis |work=[[Pro-Football-Reference.com]] |access-date=August 30, 2023}}</ref> He was also a member of the [[St. Louis Rams]].

==Early life and college==
Andre Davis was born on October 7, 1975, in [[Baton Rouge, Louisiana]].<ref name="pfa">{{cite web|url=https://www.profootballarchives.com/players/d/davi02350.html |title=Andre Davis |work=Pro Football Archives |access-date=August 30, 2023}}</ref> He attended [[Baker High School (Louisiana)|Baker High School]] in [[Baker, Louisiana]].<ref name="pfa"/>

He was a member of the [[Southern Jaguars football]] team from 1992 to 1995.<ref name="pfa"/>

==Professional career==
Davis signed with the [[St. Louis Rams]] on July 25, 1996.<ref name="transactions"/> He was released on August 20, 1996.<ref name="transactions"/>

Davis was signed to the practice squad of the [[Jacksonville Jaguars]] on August 27, 1996.<ref name="transactions"/> He was promoted to the active roster on November 12 and played in two games for the Jaguars during the 1996 season before being placed on injured reserve on November 26, 1996.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.pro-football-reference.com/players/D/DaviAn21/gamelog/1996/ | title=Andre Davis | publisher=Pro Football Reference | accessdate=10 December 2024}}</ref><ref name="transactions"/> He was released on July 15, 1997.<ref name="transactions">{{cite web | url=https://www.profootballarchives.com/transactions/d/davi02350.html | title=Andre Davis NFL Transactions | publisher=Pro Football Archives | accessdate=10 December 2024}}</ref>
